item.title: India News Today – Thursday, October 15, 2026
item.description: The Supreme Court on Thursday issued notices on a series of petitions challenging the Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision of voter rolls, and on the mass detentions of protesters and journalists in Delhi last week.
